description:
Job Title: Data Architect ETL & Data Warehousing (BFSI Focus)
Location: Chennai
Employment Type: Permanent
Experience: 10–15 years
The Data Architect will lead the design, modernization, and optimization of enterprise data
ecosystems, focusing on ETL, data warehousing, and cloud data solutions. BFSI experience is highly preferred due to domain-specific requirements involving regulatory reporting, customer data, risk systems, and core banking data flows.
This role requires more than just following instructions we need someone who proactively identifies issues, understands the "why" behind the request, and takes ownership of designing and implementing solutions. Flexibility beyond assigned roles is key in our culture.
Key Responsibilities:
Work closely with business units and product teams to elicit and structure often-implicit data requirements and convert them into business relevant information.
Design enterprise-scale data architecture across ingestion, ETL/ELT, warehousing, and analytics layers.
Build data models (conceptual, logical, physical) tailored to BFSI domains such as deposits, lending, payments, KYC, AML, credit risk, regulatory reporting, and treasury.
Architect ETL/ELT pipelines using Databrics, Azure.
Design and optimize data warehouse and data mart solutions (Kimball/Inmon/Data Vault).
Implement cloud-native data solutions on Azure with focus on security,
compliance, and performance.
Ensure adherence to BFSI regulatory standards (RBI, Basel, IFRS, GDPR Any of these).
Collaborate with business, risk, compliance, and IT teams to translate BFSI data needs into scalable architecture.
Define and enforce standards for data governance, lineage, metadata, and data quality.
Conduct impact analysis and stakeholder communication when new data sources or structural changes are introduced to the system.
Required Skills & Experience:
10–15 years in data architecture, engineering, and warehousing.
Strong experience in BFSI data platforms—core banking, risk systems, AML/KYC platforms, data lakes for regulatory needs.
Expertise in ETL tools: ETL, data engineering, data warehousing, governance, and cloud transformation, Databricks, Data analytics and Azure data pipeline
Hands-on experience with Databrics, Bigdata or Oracle.
Strong SQL, data modeling, and distributed data processing. – Any database will work –
PL SQL is preferred
Experience with cloud data services and big data tools like Spark or Databricks.
Professional Skills:
Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to convey complex analyses to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight timelines.
Proactive, innovative, and collaborative attitude with a passion for continuous learning.
Experience working with BFSI compliance, governance, and risk management teams.
Good to have:
Experience working with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working in or with Japanese-oriented companies or clients.
Databricks certification or equivalent cloud platform credentials (e.g., AWS/Azure/ GCP).
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
Cloud or data architecture certifications preferred.

title: Data Architect
description:
Data Architect Healthcare Workflows (Psych Bonus)
Own canonical JSONs, provenance fields, deltas/patches, and taxonomies across our clinical workflows. Your work ensures data consistency, traceability, and reliability , enabling safer and more effective patient care. Familiarity with the clinical mental health domain is a bonus, augmented by collaboration with domain experts like Ravi.
Values Vibe (Who You Are)
We want a meticulous, thoughtful data architect who thrives on structure, clarity, and safety . You care about data quality and consistency, and you communicate clearly with engineers, product managers, and clinicians. You enjoy designing robust data models that empower teams to ship reliable features while maintaining clinical accuracy.
A Day in Flow (The Feel, Not a Script)
Morning: review delta/patch operations, check schema validation reports, and ensure provenance fields are correct.
During sprints: define canonical patient JSONs, versioning semantics, and mapping rules across modules.
Afternoon: collaborate on safety flags, ungroundedness checks, and billing-related data clarity; update documentation and data dictionaries. Quiet impact, zero drama.
What You ll Own
Canonical JSONs Data Models: Design and maintain canonical patient JSONs and provenance fields for assessments and workflows.
Deltas, Patches Versioning: Define delta/patch semantics, versioning, and mapping across modules to ensure data consistency.
Safety Compliance Collaboration: Work with engineers and clinicians on safety/ungroundedness flags and billing clarity.
Documentation Knowledge Sharing: Maintain clear documentation, schemas, and taxonomies to support engineering and clinical teams.
Domain Expertise Augmentation: Integrate clinical mental health specifics with guidance from subject matter experts.
Authority (Ramped on Purpose)
You ll own the data architecture standards for clinical workflows from day one. Scope ramps as you deliver: enforce JSON schema best practices, maintain provenance, ensure safe versioning, and escalate inconsistencies or potential data risks early with full team support.
Schedule (India)
Works daytime hours with 4-8 hours of overlap to US Pacific (e.g., 11:00am-7:00pm CT / 9:00am-5:00pm PT), with flexibility for cross-functional sessions with engineers and clinical experts.
What Success Looks Like
Canonical JSONs are consistent, validated, and integrated across all workflows.
Delta/patch versioning is robust, traceable, and reliable.
Safety and ungroundedness flags are effective and actionable.
Billing and clinical data mapping are clear and maintainable.
Teams rely on your data architecture for correctness, safety, and efficiency.
What You ve Done
4+ years in data modeling , JSON schema design, and event sourcing/versioning.
Strong experience in defining canonical data structures, provenance models, and deltas/patches.
Familiarity with healthcare data is a plus; mental health domain experience is highly valued.
Excellent communication and collaboration across technical and clinical teams.
Preferred: experience designing data taxonomies, clinical data pipelines, or event-driven architectures.
Benefits
Remote-first across India
Equipment stipend
Local holidays (India)
Learning budget for data modeling, healthcare workflows, and clinical data best practices
Job Type: Full-time Remote

We are implementing ZingHR Payroll and are looking for a hands-on Payroll + HRIS (techno-functional) specialist who can drive the end-to-end payroll implementation (configuration support, UAT, parallel run, go-live) and then own monthly payroll operations with statutory compliance and controls.

A) ZingHR Payroll Implementation (Project Phase)

Lead payroll implementation activities on ZingHR in coordination with HR, Finance, IT and ZingHR/vendor teams.
Conduct requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis, and finalize payroll design, including salary structures, earnings/deductions, statutory rules, and approval workflows.
Configure and validate payroll rules/mappings (earnings, deductions, arrears, reimbursements, OT/shift allowances, loans/advances, etc.).
Own master data readiness: employee masters, organization structure, cost centers, bank details, statutory numbers, and salary structures.
Plan and execute data migration (templates, validation, reconciliation) with strong accuracy checks.
Drive UAT, issue tracking, defect closure, and sign-offs with stakeholders.
Manage parallel runs (minimum 12 cycles recommended), reconcile outputs with legacy payroll, and stabilize variances.
Prepare the go-live plan, cutover checklist, payroll calendar, and SOPs, and train HR/payroll users.
Ensure integration readiness with attendance/leave, biometrics, finance/ERP, and bank file formats (as applicable).
B) Payroll Operations (BAU Post Go-Live)

Own end-to-end monthly payroll processing: attendance inputs, validations, payroll computation, approvals, payslip release, and closure.
Ensure statutory compliance: PF, ESI, PT, LWF, IT-TDS (as applicable), including remittances, returns, and documentation.
Handle Full & Final settlement, gratuity/bonus (where applicable), arrears, revisions, and exit settlements within TAT.
Manage payroll reconciliations with Finance (salary control accounts, provisions, bank advice) and audit readiness.
Maintain employee query resolution (payroll helpdesk), corrections, and controlled re-runs if required.
Publish payroll MIS reports: headcount, cost center payroll, variance analysis, overtime/allowance reports, statutory summaries.
Ensure data confidentiality, internal controls, and compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
Must-Have Skills/Competencies

Strong hands-on payroll operations experience with good statutory knowledge: PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and Income Tax (TDS).
Proven experience in HRMS Payroll implementation or major payroll transition (end-to-end lifecycle).
Strong reconciliation mindset: variance analysis, audit trails, and data accuracy controls.
Stakeholder management: ability to work with HR, Finance, IT, and vendors.
Advanced Excel skills; payroll validation and reporting capability.
Good-to-Have (Preferred)

Prior working experience on ZingHR Payroll (implementation/support/operations).
Exposure to attendance integration, shift/OT rules, multi-location payroll, and contractor payroll coordination.
Experience with bank file generation, finance posting, cost center allocations, and payroll provisioning.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job purpose:
Own end-to-end strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Combine solution architecture (data lakehouse/warehouse, streaming, governance) with hands-on engineering (Python, PySpark, Scala) and TPM leadership (road mapping, cross-team coordination, delivery governance). Lead discovery, design, and execution of secure, scalable, and cost-optimized data solutions, mentor teams, and communicate value to senior stakeholders.
Duties and responsibilities of position:
General areas of responsibility relate to:
• Lead discovery workshops; translate business objectives into data platform architectures and outcome-based roadmaps.
Architect GCP-native solutions integrating BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc/Spark, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI (as applicable), and IAM. • Define and enforce governance, security, and compliance (RBAC/IAM, data masking, lineage, retention, GDPR/HIPAA/SOC 2).
Establish delivery frameworks: backlog & milestones, RACI, estimation, resourcing, CI/CD, environment management, and operational readiness.
• Drive FinOps and performance optimization: capacity planning, cost monitoring, and efficiency improvements.
• Mentor architects/consultants/engineers; set coding standards, review designs, and guide technical decisions.
• Act as the primary client interface for solution walkthroughs, trade-off analysis, risk management, and executive updates.
Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to:
• Design lakehouse/warehouse architectures: Cloud Storage Dataproc/Spark BigQuery (ELT), with curated zones (bronze/silver/gold).
Define streaming patterns using Pub/Sub + Dataflow / Spark Structured Streaming; implement CDC via connectors/Debezium (if applicable).
• Select the right compute engines (Dataproc vs. Dataflow vs. BigQuery SQL), storage formats (Parquet/Delta/Iceberg), and workload isolation. • Lead development of modular pipelines in PySpark/Scala (Dataproc) and Python utilities/APIs; enforce packaging, logging, testing.
Implement SCD Type 1/Type 2 and CDC (watermarks, MERGE/upsert strategies); handle schema evolution & late-arriving data.
• Optimize Spark workloads (partitioning, predicate pushdown, broadcast joins, shuffle tuning, checkpointing); remediate small-file issues. • Model star/snowflake schemas, conformed dimensions, and KPI-aligned fact tables; define semantic consistency and data contracts. • Tune BigQuery: table partitioning/clustering, materialized views, query plan review, BI integration (Looker/Power BI/Tableau).
• Implement IAM/RBAC, VPC-SC, CMEK (encryption keys), DLP (where applicable), row/column-level security in BigQuery.
Establish catalogue/lineage (Data Catalogue, Looker semantic layer, or third-party), tagging/classification, retention & legal hold policies.
• Set up Git-based workflows and CI/CD (Cloud Build / GitHub Actions) for Spark jobs, Python packages, SQL/dbt models, and infra.
Use Terraform/Deployment Manager for IaC (projects, IAM, networking, data services); define promotion gates (devtestprod), secrets/variables, rollback/DR.
• Build telemetry & dashboards: pipeline SLAs/SLOs, freshness/latency, failure rates; set alerts and lead RCA.
• Optimize compute/storage cost: autoscaling, spot/preemptible workers, reservation planning, lifecycle policies, usage tagging; forecast and track budgets.
Other duties:
Own program planning: multi-quarter roadmaps, dependency mapping, interface agreements across app/BI/security/network teams.
• Run governance ceremonies (steerco, risk reviews, change control), drive decisions, and manage stakeholder communication.
Ensure delivery against milestones with quality gates, non-functional requirements, and compliance checklists.
Lead POCs to validate architecture decisions (streaming throughput, SCD2 performance, BigQuery optimization, governance integration).
• Contribute to proposals, SOWs, and effort models; support pre-sales and solution accelerators.
• Produce executive reports on platform health, risk posture, compliance, and cost; socialize best practices company-wide.
• Provide after-hours support for critical incidents/releases on a rotational basis.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• Experience: 810 years in data engineering/analytics; 4+ years architecting on GCP; proven TPM/lead experience.
• Technical Expertise:
GCP: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc (Spark), Dataflow (Beam), Pub/Sub, Composer (Airflow), Cloud Functions, IAM, VPC-SC; Terraform/IaC.
Languages: Python, PySpark, Scala (DataFrames/Spark SQL/Structured Streaming); packaging, testing (pytest), performance profiling. o Patterns: CDC/SCD1/SCD2, medallion/lakehouse, ELT in BigQuery, schema evolution, data contracts.
Modelling & Tuning: star/snowflake, clustering/partitioning, materialized views, caching, query optimization (Spark & BigQuery).
Security/Governance: IAM/RBAC, encryption keys (CMEK), DLP/classification, catalogue/lineage, compliance (GDPR/HIPAA/SOC 2).
DevOps: Git workflows, CI/CD (Cloud Build/GitHub Actions), Terraform, environment promotion, secrets management, DR.

Leading workshops, authoring HLD/LLD, trade-off analysis, and change management.
Mentoring and cross-team leadership; enforcing delivery discipline and quality gates.
Executive-grade communication and the ability to simplify complex technical topics for business stakeholders.

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible
As the Data & Analytics (D&A) Manager India Data Hub & Enterprise, you will be involved in envisioning, enabling, and executing a D&A strategy aimed at digitizing key work process in Mondelz India. The role will be accountable for the Data Strategy and India along with the accountability for the Data Hub (Data Lake) contents, and the Business Intelligence applications built off it. The ideal candidate will be passionate about Business Digital Transformation, solving business problems with data & analytics, have excellent communication skills, and be able to effectively engage and manage a diverse group of individuals. This role is expected to work with various parts of Data & Analytics organization, external partners, multiple functional (Finance, Sales, Supply Chain and Consumer-Marketing) teams as well as Business leaders to successfully deliver the Data Hub & Enterprise agenda for Mondelz India.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Lead and manage the Mondelez Data Hub and Enterprise program as the D&A representative partnering the broader Digital Council within Mondelz India. Bring expertise on Data, Business Process, Technology and Analytics to develop and implement strategies to increase the data and analytics quotient of the broader organization.
Own the contents of India Data Hub (Data Lake), Community Site, and the Business Intelligence applications built off it. This involves governing the data ingestion plans, application development/deployment plans led by other D&A colleagues and govern its continuous improvement plans. Is expected to lead a team of Mondelz D&A professionals and external partners with to deliver the program and drive adoption of the applications and data assets.
Drive governance and adoption of the Data Hub and its application, this role is expected to partner multifunctional teams to drive Digitization Change Management via delivering technical trainings and co-develop business relevant contents.
Review adoption metrics and device improvement plans based on periodic feedback workshops. Monitor and respond to community questions, and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
Owns the Data Hub onboarding, and upskilling learning pathways. Partners both internal and external resources to curate and upkeep the curriculum. Develop and maintain relationships with influencers, thought leaders, and experts un the various Functions and Business Units to better understand requirements of the data and application users.
Provide support to Mondelzs Functions and Business Units, with art-of-possible workshops, and leverage the broader D&A community to inspire impactful use-cases and implementations.

Creating value from business-driven data and analytics initiatives at scale. An important task for the Data & Analytics Manager is to support the business and other stakeholders in their solving their business problems via relevant data & analytics. This means they will support the business during various stages. In the inspiration phase they help the business in identifying the right use cases and support prioritization based on feasibility and value. In the ideation phase they help with the development of a minimum viable product and business case. During the implementation phase they make sure the service or product is adopted (by the employees), embedded in the workflow (process) and measured for impact.
Helps uncover and translate business requirements and stakeholder needs. This translation needs to be done in such a way that the technical specialists in the D&A team can understand (Data Management, Analytics Products, Partners and / or Data Science resources). This requires an understanding of both the business objectives, goals, and domain expertise, as well as data, analytics and technology concepts, methods, and techniques. It also requires strong soft skills with a focus on communication.

Data & analytics skills
Must have a good understanding of the concepts, methods and techniques used:
Analytics, for example diagnostic, descriptive, predictive and prescriptive.
Data management, for example data integration (ETL) or metadata.
Data architecture, for example the difference between data warehouse, data lake or data hub.
Data modelling, for creation of right reusable data assets
Data governance, for example MDM, data quality and data stewardship practices.

Technology skills
Good understanding of the tools and technologies in the D&A team:
Programming languages like SQL, Python or R and notebooks like R Studio or Jupyter.
Data integration tools like Informatica or Talend.
Analytics and Business Intelligence tools like Microsoft Power BI or Tableau.

Soft skills
Leadership with high level of self-initiative and drive, for example leading the discussions on D&A agenda in the BU and building a combined vision across multiple stakeholders
Communication, for example conveying information to diverse audiences in a way that is easily understood and actionable.
Facilitation and conflict resolution, for example hosting sessions to elicit ideas from others, understand their issues and encourage group participation.
Creative thinking and being comfortable with unknown or unchartered territories, for example framing new concepts for business teams and brainstorming with business users about future product and services.
Teamwork, for example working with both business domain teams as well as D&A teams and MDS stakeholders.
Collaboration, for example fostering group problem solving and solution creation with business and technical team members.
Relationship management, for example creating relationships and builds trust with internal and external stakeholders quickly.
Storytelling, for example by creating a consistent, clear storyline for better understanding
Influencing, for example by asserting ideas and persuading others to gain support across an organization or to adopt new behaviors.
Domain skills
Must have a good understanding of the business process and associated data:
Business Acumen, for example understanding business concepts, practices and business domain language to engage in problem solving sessions and discuss business issues in stakeholder language. Relevant experience in Data and Analytics CPG or FMCG is preferred.
Business Process Transformation, for example ability to understand how D&A can help redesign the way work is done.
Business data, cross-functional knowledge, ideal to have experience in Finance and Supply Chain (specifically with SAP systems).
Other skills
Agility, Growth mindset will be crucial
Project management capabilities including ability to manage risks, for example understanding of project management concepts to organize their own work and the ability to collaborate with project managers to align business expectations with the D&A team delivery capabilities.
Vendor negotiation and effort estimation skills, for example to manage the right partner skills at right cost based on the complexity and importance of the initiatives to be delivered or supported
Business case development, for example to help develop support for the experimenting selected use cases or measure the impact/business value created. For this the role can collaborate with business analysts in supply chain.
Decision modelling, for example, supports decision makers and improves complicated decisions that involve trade-offs among alternative courses of action by using decision-problem models.
UX/design, for example by creating products and visualizations that are easy to work with and support the activities required by the end users.

Strong understanding of database technologies (relational and cloud-based), Big Data technologies, and data integration patterns. Knowledge of XMI, XML, JSON, or similar data communication languages is an advantage.

Lead the design, development, and maintece of robust, scalable cloud-based data processing pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring adherence to engineering standards, goverce frameworks, and industry best practices.
Architect and refine data models for large-scale datasets, optimizing for efficient storage, high-performance retrieval, and advanced analytics while upholding data integrity and quality.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into effective, scalable data engineering solutions that drive organizational value.
Champion a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, proactively identifying and implementing enhancements to data infrastructure, processing workflows, and analytics capabilities.

Drive data quality initiatives, ensure seamless data accessibility for analysts and data scientists, and maintain strict compliance with data goverce and regulatory requirements.
Align data engineering practices with business objectives, ensuring solutions are both technically sound and strategically relevant.
Author, review, and approve technical requirements and architectural designs, and lead process re-engineering efforts to deliver cost-effective, high-impact business solution

Expert in at least two programming languages (Python, and Java)
Expert in at least one distributed data processing framework (Spark)
Expert in at least one cloud data Lakehouse platforms (AWS Data lake services or Databricks, if not Hadoop),

PhD or masters in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research or Economics, Analytics, Data Science. Or bachelors with additional experience.

The role involves collaborating closely with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to create scalable, production-grade ML/AI models that align with the organizations strategic goals. Additionally, the Senior ML/AI Engineer will drive innovation by exploring new AI methodologies, including large language models, and integrating them into data solutions for enhanced customer engagement and business insights.




DESCRIBE THE MAIN ACTIVITIES OF THE JOB (DESCRIPTION)

Machine Learning Model Development:


Build, train, and deploy advanced machine learning models, including regression, classification, clustering, and recommendation algorithms, that deliver business value.

Implement NLP, deep learning, and computer vision solutions as required to support customer-centric applications and predictive analytics.

Apply knowledge of large language models (LLMs) to develop conversational AI and recommendation systems for customer engagement.


AI System Design & Deployment:


Design end-to-end ML/AI pipelines that support the continuous integration and deployment of machine learning models into production environments.

Leverage MLOps best practices for model versioning, retraining, performance monitoring, and scalability.

Ensure models are optimized for latency, accuracy, and scalability by deploying on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.


Data Gathering and Preprocessing:


Collaborate with data engineering teams to design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for AI-specific data needs.

Engineer and preprocess large, complex datasets from various sources to ensure model robustness, accuracy, and generalizability.

Contribute to the centralized data knowledge management system to streamline data access for ML/AI use cases.


Predictive Analytics & Foresight Generation:


Perform predictive analytics to support business strategies, creating foresight-driven models that enhance customer experiences and drive revenue growth.

Evaluate and implement techniques for model interpretability, explainability, and bias reduction.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:


Partner with business stakeholders to identify areas where ML/AI can drive value, and translate these into actionable AI projects.

Work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and software development teams to ensure successful model deployment and alignment with data architecture.

Document processes, code, and models for knowledge sharing and team scalability.


Continuous Improvement & Research:


Stay updated on advancements in ML/AI, particularly LLMs and generative AI, and identify opportunities to apply these innovations to business problems.

Conduct ongoing model evaluation and improvement based on performance metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business needs.

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

5+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or data science, with a track record of successfully deploying models in production.

Extensive experience working with large datasets, building and fine-tuning ML models, and deploying on cloud platforms.

Demonstrated expertise in deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and familiarity with NLP and large language models.
